# Third-party browser libraries

These are local copies of the existing application dependencies, obtained on 2026-11-14 to avoid runtime CDN availability requirements. Versions were preserved, not security-upgraded. Each distribution includes its upstream license header; all three libraries use the MIT license.

- `chart.min.js`: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/3.7.0/chart.min.js
- `jspdf.umd.min.js`: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js
- `html2canvas.min.js`: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js

Review upstream advisories before deployment, especially the older jsPDF release.
